class.name: PhysXDestructible3D
class.brief_description: A scene node that displays a [PhysXBlastAsset] and fractures it into physics-driven chunks on damage.
class.description: Wraps NVIDIA Blast destructibles. Assign an authored [PhysXBlastAsset] to [member blast_asset], and the node spawns the asset's chunk scene under itself. Impacts and [method apply_radial_damage] reduce [member health]; when it runs out, the destructible fractures: the affected chunks detach, become rigid-body-backed debris, and the [signal chunks_fractured] signal fires. Chunks falling below [member kill_y] are cleaned up.

method.name: apply_radial_damage
method.description: Applies explosion-style damage at [param world_position], falloff from [param max_radius] to [param min_radius]. Chunks whose accumulated damage exceeds their health fracture off and [signal chunks_fractured] fires.

method.name: get_piece_chunk
method.description: Which authored chunk piece [param index] renders/simulates; [code]4294967295[/code] when the index is out of range.

method.name: get_piece_count
method.description: How many chunk pieces are currently alive (intact placeholder included, before the first fracture). Diagnostics for tests and tooling.

method.name: get_piece_transform
method.description: World transform of piece [param index]'s body; identity for an out-of-range index or an editor (render-only) piece.

method.name: is_fractured
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once a hit or [method apply_radial_damage] has broken anything off (stays true; agrees with the [signal chunks_fractured] signal).

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once the assigned [member blast_asset] has been loaded and its chunk scene spawned.

members.member: Static destructibles only ([member dynamic] off): which pieces of a fractured wall stay put instead of falling. [b]Framed[/b] keeps every piece still touching the intact mesh's sides, bottom or top (a wall built into something holds its place); [b]Grounded[/b] keeps only bottom-touching pieces (a freestanding wall drops its upper half in one rigid chunk); [b]None[/b] drops everything. Leaf debris always falls regardless of the mode.
Optional path override for where fracture chunks are spawned from.
If [code]true[/code], detached chunks derive their mass from their size; otherwise [member mass] is used.
The authored asset to instance and fracture. See [PhysXBlastAuthoring] for authoring.
Optional path override for the spawned chunk debris.
Collision layer of the intact destructible and of detached chunks.
Collision mask of the intact destructible and of detached chunks.
If [code]true[/code], the intact destructible participates in physics; if [code]false[/code] it is static until fractured.
Global damage pool. Reaching zero fractures the whole destructible.

If [code]true[/code], the chunk pieces' render instances are never occlusion-culled, mirroring [member GeometryInstance3D.ignore_occlusion_culling]. Applied to every existing piece on set and to pieces spawned afterwards.
Multiplier applied to collision impact damage.
Radius of the damage zone used for impact-based fracturing.
Minimum impulse magnitude that counts as a damaging impact.
World-space Y below which detached chunks are freed (and their Blast actors retired, so a later hit cannot re-spawn them).

Makes a detached piece static once PhysX has put it to sleep: it stays, solid, but never moves or wakes again -- a settled pile stops costing solver time. Frozen pieces ignore [member debris_lifetime].

A detached piece is removed this many seconds after it spawned (0 = never). In its last [member debris_shrink] seconds it shrinks to nothing instead of popping out. Static anchored pieces and frozen pieces never age.
How long a piece's shrink-to-nothing takes, at the end of [member debris_lifetime]. While shrinking it is static and collides with nothing.
Mass used for detached chunks when [member auto_mass] is off.
Impact speed above which an impact is treated as an immediate shatter.
Opacity of the chunk pieces' render instances ([code]0.0[/code] = fully opaque, [code]1.0[/code] = fully transparent). Applied to every existing piece on set and to pieces spawned afterwards.

signal.name: chunks_fractured
signal.description: Emitted after a fracture event: [param world_position] is the damage center, [param pieces_spawned] the number of detached chunks, [param damage] the applied damage.

constants.constant: Pieces still touching the intact mesh's sides, bottom or top stay static.
Only pieces touching the intact mesh's bottom stay static.
